description:
Stretcher, Mobile, CRS, 9 Position 

  1. Electric Stretcher
    1. Must be electric powered lift
    2. Must include Chaperone bed exit system- two zone alarm
    3. Shall have big wheel to reduce start up push force and steering
    4. Maximum 700 lb. weight capacity
    5. Must be capable of less than 21-inch low height
    6. Must have Height range: high 34" and low 20.75"
    7. Must include litter-mounted oxygen bottle holder
    8. Must have center-locking brake system with dual end activators
    9. Must have power washable design
    10. Must have dual, side-mounted foot control hydraulics with uni-lower pedal
    11. Must have dual end brake/steer controls
    12. Must have glide away side rails
    13. Must include four (4) integrated IV receptacles
    14. Must be capable of ±17°Trendelenburg
    15. Must include five (5) 8-inch omni surface casters with integrated wheel covers
    16. Must include pneumatic backrest/stationary foot
    17. Must have thermoformed ABS base
    18. Must include integrated utility tray
    19. Must include integrated transfer board
    20. Must have electric patient controls
    21. Must include lift assist backrest
    22. Must be capable of recovery chair position
  2. Dimension: 35”D x 85”W x 33”H
  3. Quantity: 2
